what: `blaze stop` answers before the daemon's process has exited. A daemon started at once at the same home path (the old home renamed away) ended with exit 1, `USAGE: its command line was refused ... while finding its build and its state`, once in a 21-case run.
cost: one false failure of a clean build, 15 minutes to find
cause: stop is acknowledged before exit; what the second daemon tripped on I did not find (its log was replaced)
workaround: the harness waits for the pid to be gone after `blaze stop`
state: open: unknown cause; the harness works around it
